title: Create Job Posting
description: A posting must be built from an approved recruitment request - the Hiring Manager's sign-off publishes it

jdUpload.title: JD Document (PDF/DOCX)
jdUpload.description: Upload JD file → AI analyzes and auto-fills title, skills, level, description... You can still edit below.
jdUpload.success: JD analyzed and fields auto-filled. You can still edit.
jdUpload.warning: The file was saved but AI could not clearly recognise it as a job description. Please review and fill the fields below manually.
jdUpload.clickToViewHint: Click the file name to review the JD
jdUpload.failed: The file was saved but AI did not finish the analysis (service error or timeout). Fill the fields manually, or retry with a smaller file.
jdUpload.failedScanned: This PDF contains only images (a scan or slide export), so AI could not read its text in time. The file is still saved — fill the fields manually, or use a text-based JD file so AI can auto-fill.
jdUpload.scannedHint: Note: this PDF has no text layer (images only), so the auto-filled values may be incomplete — please double-check them.
jdUpload.fromComposer: This JD file came from the company-template composer. Uploading another file replaces it.

form.vacanciesHint: Hiring target — you can close the job when target is reached.
form.onlineTestHint: This round uses the job's question bank. After creating the job, open "Online Test" to add questions and set the pass score / duration.
form.onlineTestLanguageNotice: Questions must be written in {{language}}. After creating the job, open "Question bank" and update the questions to match — uploaded Excel files are checked and rejected if the language does not match.
form.interviewPassScoreHint: At or above this score the AI concludes "pass" (0–100). Applies only when an interview scoring rubric is configured in the Playbook.
form.hiringManagerNone: — Not assigned (you can add one later) —
form.hiringManagerHint: The department lead who approves candidates, signs off the job description and makes the final interview call. Leave empty and the job runs with no approval gates, exactly as before.
form.hmAssignFailed: The job was created but the Hiring Manager could not be assigned. You can assign one from the job page.
form.goToJobToAssign: Open the job page to assign a Hiring Manager

validation.requiredFields: Title and Job Description are required.
validation.jdRequired: Please upload and analyze JD file (PDF/DOCX) before creating the job.
validation.locationRequired: Work location is required when interview mode is not Remote.
validation.loadError: Unable to load job posting data.
validation.saveError: An error occurred while saving the job posting.
validation.recruitmentRequestRequired: A job posting must be built from an approved recruitment request. Open your assigned request and click "Build job posting from this request".

recruitmentRequest.title: Recruitment request
recruitmentRequest.description: Every job posting must be built from a request raised by a Hiring Manager and approved by the HR Leader. Pick the request first — the fields below are pre-filled from it.
recruitmentRequest.prefillHint: Title, department, salary range, headcount and the job description draft were filled in from the request. You can still edit them below.
recruitmentRequest.none: No request is eligible. A request must be approved, assigned to you, and not yet turned into a posting.
